parameters.content:
# 🍽️ Restaurant Voice Assistant — System Overview

This workflow is the **backend brain** for an ElevenLabs Conversational AI voice agent that answers restaurant phone calls. The agent itself lives entirely in ElevenLabs — this n8n workflow only exposes **5 webhook endpoints** that the agent calls as "Tools" (Server Tools / Webhook Tools) whenever it needs to read or write real data during a live call.

## 🔗 How ElevenLabs connects
Inside the ElevenLabs Agent configuration, 5 custom tools are defined (Webhook type). Each tool's **Production URL** points to one of the webhook nodes below. When a caller says something like "I'd like to book a table for 4 on Friday at 8pm," the LLM inside ElevenLabs decides which tool to call, extracts the required parameters from the conversation, and sends a POST request to that tool's webhook URL. n8n runs the corresponding branch, talks to Google Sheets / Gmail, and returns a JSON response — which ElevenLabs reads back to the caller in real time.

## 🧰 The 5 Tools / Sub-Workflows

**1. make_reservation** (`/restaurant_reservation`)
Collects customer_name, phone_number, party_size, date, time, special_requests, conversation_id from the agent. Normalizes the data, appends a new row to the *Reservations* sheet, emails the manager a formatted confirmation, and returns a spoken confirmation message + status back to the agent.

**2. check_availability** (`/check_availability`)
Called *before* a booking is confirmed. Reads all rows from *Reservations*, normalizes date/time formats, sums up party sizes already booked for that date+time slot, compares against a fixed table capacity (40), and tells the agent whether the slot is available — with a natural-language message the agent can say to the caller (offering to check another time if full).

**3. place_order** (`/restaurant_order`)
For pickup/delivery orders. Captures customer_name, phone_number, items, order_type (pickup/delivery), delivery_address, appends the order to the *orders* sheet, emails the manager the order details, and confirms receipt to the caller.

**4. manage_reservation** (`/manage_reservation`)
Handles both **cancel** and **modify** in one tool, based on an `action` field sent by the agent. It looks up the existing reservation by phone_number + date, and:
  • if `action = cancel` → deletes the row from *Reservations* and emails the manager a cancellation notice
  • if `action = modify` → merges any new_date / new_time / new_party_size fields over the existing row (falling back to original values if not provided), updates the sheet, and emails the manager the change
  If no matching reservation is found, it politely tells the caller to double-check their details.

**5. request_human_callback** (`/request_human_callback`)
Escalation path for anything the AI can't resolve. Logs customer_name, phone_number, and reason to the *Escalations* sheet, fires an urgent alert email to the manager (with a click-to-call link), and confirms to the caller that a team member will follow up.

## 📊 Data store
All flows read/write a single Google Sheet with 3 tabs: **Reservations**, **orders**, and **Escalations**. Manager notification emails are sent via Gmail for every create/cancel/modify/escalation event, so staff always have a real-time inbox record alongside the sheet.

## ⚙️ Setup notes for template users
After importing, set your own Google Sheets document ID + credentials, your own Gmail account, and copy each webhook node's **Production URL** into the matching Tool in your ElevenLabs Agent config. Table capacity (40) in the *Check Capacity* code node can be edited to match your venue.
